criteria.notes: Pickup queue: called ticket, destination counter, readiness note and a numbered next-up list with waiting count, across called, waiting and cleared states.
Pharmacy queue-display concept preserved: single dominant ticket panel beside a compact upcoming list.
Reads as a purpose-built queue caller, not a dashboard; one number dominates the surface as it must at a counter.
The called ticket is the largest element by a wide margin and stays legible at 480x270; next-up rows keep their status text above the floor.
Dark-theme scenario preserves the green identity band, ticket contrast and on-hold warning colour.
Long-label and long-next-label scenarios clamp counter and prescription text without losing the ticket identifier.
The ticket panel and list divide the surface fully; one-ticket, empty and unknown-state scenarios substitute intentional messages rather than leaving gaps.
Identity mark and status glyphs render crisply at the compact 480x270 target with no raster media to degrade.
The single-hero queue caller is structurally distinct from the multi-panel dashboard examples.
